issues.title: [Bug] "Run as goal" on a plan's Improve action arms an implement objective, so the agent starts executing the plan

en.headline: 5 commits across 3 repositories, plus 1 issue opened
en.summary: The day included **5 commits** across three repositories, with 3 additional automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 2 own commits re-fetched the full local `10-23` dataset after merging and re-rendered it, then fixed missed personal attribution using a SHA list. In `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, 2 own commits required the user's global Git identity for commits and added Chrome built-in translation while splitting contributor documentation. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, 1 own commit equalized card heights, changed headings to sans serif, and added orange interactions and example boxes. The user opened or closed 1 issue: `openchamber/openchamber` issue #5489, “[Bug] "Run as goal" on a plan's Improve action arms an implement objective, so the agent starts executing the plan”, which remains open with 1 comment. No pull requests, reviews, releases, discussions, replies, or state changes were recorded.

zh.headline: 3 个仓库共 5 次提交，另新开 1 个 issue
zh.summary: 当天在三个仓库完成 **5 次提交**，另有 3 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 2 次本人提交中，先在合并后按本地整份重新获取 `10-23` 数据并重渲染，随后通过 SHA 名单修复漏计的本人提交。在 `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 的 2 次本人提交中，要求提交使用用户的全局 Git 身份，并加入 Chrome 内置翻译及拆分贡献者文档。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 1 次本人提交中，统一卡片高度、将标题改为无衬线字体，并加入橙色交互和示例框。用户新开或关闭了 1 个 issue：`openchamber/openchamber` 的 #5489“[Bug] "Run as goal" on a plan's Improve action arms an implement objective, so the agent starts executing the plan”，该 issue 仍为开放状态，并有 1 条评论。当天没有记录到 pull request、评审、发布、讨论、回复或状态变更。
